title: Kilthane
summary: Kilthane, the Black Knight, is utterly loyal to his Seeker and never retreats from battle. He wears a dark, slate-colored suit of armor with blades that resemble insect legs protruding from behind his cape. He bears a curved blade and a shield with a green dragon for a crest. Kilthane Titans are known to be used by Zhalia Moon and Ryder, and they are worthy and mighty allies.

sections.heading: Zhalia's Kilthane
sections.text:
Zhalia Moon came into possession of a Kilthane Amulet during her teenage years while working for the Organization. [S1E11] 

During the fight for the Amulet of Metagolem in the Golem's Attic, Zhalia invoked her Kilthane Titan. He was attacked by some Suits. After the defeat of Caliban, Kilthane attacked Grier's Breaker but was overpowered and defeated. [Words of Truth, Heart of Lies] 

Kilthane was later invoked to fight the Organization in the Cave of the Gargoyle. Kilthane fought some Redcap Titans and Breaker but was defeated. [Into the River of Secrets] In the Paris Catacombs, Kilthane fought against the Knights of Arc's Inner Circle but was defeated. [Crawling the Catacombs] Zhalia invoked Kilthane to fight DeFoe's forces. Kilthane shielded Zhalia from DeFoe's attacks and defeated some Redcap Titans but was injured by Kreutalk's Acid Attack ability. When Dante arrived, Kilthane recovered and, along with Caliban, advanced on DeFoe and his Suits, forcing them to retreat. [Divide and Conquer]

Zhalia summoned Kilthane in Iceland to fight against Ymir's army of Ice Creatures. [The Legacy of Thor] Zhalia later invoked Kilthane in the Temple of Thor to protect Dante from the wild Titan, Fenris. Although Kilthane delivered a powerful strike on Fenris, he was defeated due to the temple's effect on Fenris' strength. [Two Powers Become One]

Kilthane was invoked in the Basilisk House a surprise attack on DeFoe and his men. Kilthane charged at Mindrone before being bear-hugged by Breaker. He was freed when Sophie's Sabriel hit Breaker and retreated with Zhalia, Sophie and Sabriel, closely followed by Grier, a Suit, Breaker and Mindrone. [Absent Heroes]

Kilthane was mentioned by Cherit to be heavy enough to walk underwater. Zhalia invoked Kilthane to cover the team after a surprise attack made by DeFoe's forces. [The Treasures of the Argonauts] On Madea Island, an illusion of Kilthane was invoked by an illusion of Zhalia to attack the real Zhalia. However, the illusional Kilthane was defeated by Caliban. [The Beautiful Trap]

In Newgrange Passage Tomb, Kilthane fought and defeated a Bonelasher in a fight with Klaus' Suits. [Home Turf] Zhalia later summoned Kilthane to fight against a Bonelasher and Enforcer in Klaus' lab, in order to maintain her cover as a double agent. [The Bookshop Hunter] In the Castle of Vlad Dracul, Kilthane fought against Sabriel, Feyone and Icarus in the Castle of Vlad Dracul. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs]

At the Temple of Poseidon, Kilthane fought against Rassimov's Anubian but was defeated. [The Unseen Guide] Kilthane attacked and defeated an Enforcer in Ethiopia. [The Golden Asp] Later, in King Solomon's Mines, Kilthane fought with the Professor's Dominator, only to be defeated by Rassimov's Hopeshatter power. [To Be Together]

On the roof of Dante's house, Zhalia invoked Kilthane against the Professor. However, Araknos's Mastermind ability took control of Kilthane leading to him fighting with Sabriel and Lindorm before being defeated by Caliban. [The Secret of Two Generations] At the Professor's castle Kilthane fought alongside Lok's Freelancer against Jokoul and Strix. Kilthane then stabbed and defeated Terrapede. [The Divine Comedy]

On a mission to the English coast, Kilthane was invoked to defend the Huntik team from the Casterwill guardians, Mallory and White. Kilthane then defeated White's Feyone. [Cave of the Casterwills] Kilthane was later summoned in the Casterwill Library and concealed by Zhalia's Thoughtspecter power. He later overpowered Lane in order to stop Lucas Casterwill's team. [Chasing Void]

On the longest night of the year, Zhalia invoked Kilthane during a cave-in to help her carry Den and Harrison Fears to safety. When Zhalia went to fight the Betrayer, Kilthane was ordered to guard the two brothers but was sacrificed by Harrison's Powermark spell to give both Harrison and Den energy to battle the Betrayer. [Lok and the Betrayer]

sections.heading: Ryder's Kilthane
sections.wikitext: Another Kilthane [[Amulet]] is in the possession of [[Ryder]]. {{Source|The Titan of the Forest}} Ryder invoked his Kilthane in Sherwood Forest to battle Zhalia's Kilthane resulting in a standoff between the two. Both were sent back to their Amulets when the roof of the building collapsed under the weight of [[Ford]]'s [[Belgrieve]]. {{Source|The Titan of the Forest}}

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S1E03 Kilthane Raypulse.jpg|thumb|Kilthane blocks a [[Raypulse]] with his shield]]
Kilthane is a powerful brawler Titan. He can use his large sword to cut at his enemies. His shield is immensely strong for defense and his tough armor gives him an additional boost to his defense. Kilthane's ability is called "Knight's Charge" which sends him straight into battle with immense speed, strength and accuracy. A fine Titan warrior, Kilthane is totally covered in armor, and he is always ready for battle. According to [[Cherit]], Kilthane is heavy enough to fight underwater. {{Source|The Treasures of the Argonauts}}

sections.heading: Design History
sections.wikitext:
Kilthane's appearance was based on the black knight, a mysterious knight of unknown allegiance. The long, sharp blades on his back were thought by the designers to make Kilthane appear like a spider, even though only six blades are present. He is clad in dark, gothic armor and bears a cape, giving a bit of an evil overlord appearance. Down to the detail of the dragon on his shield and his curved blade, this knight-like Titan was made to be intimidating. {{source|Huntik.com}}
